messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or a holiday that is observed on the nearest weekday when it lands on a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 was a Sunday; the holiday was observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Family Day fell on Monday Feb 20. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday & Easter Monday | Good Friday was on Friday Apr 7; Easter Monday on Monday Apr 10. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day was on Monday May 22. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day | Canada Day fell on Saturday Jul 1; it was observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day was on Monday Sep 4. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving was on Monday Oct 9. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday Nov 11; it was observed on Monday Nov 13. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Christmas was on Monday Dec 25. |

> **Optional provincial long weekends**  
> • **Family Day** in Manitoba (Feb 20) and New Brunswick (Feb 20) – same dates as above.  
> • **St. John’s Day** (June 24) in New Brunswick – not a federal holiday but often treated as a short break.  
> • **St. Patrick’s Day** (March 17) in Newfoundland & Labrador – observed on Monday Mar 20 in 2023.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the full list of all public holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends) or province‑specific variations, let me know!
